MorpheApp/MicroG-RE.name: MorpheApp/MicroG-RE
MorpheApp/MicroG-RE.body:
### Bug fixes

* Implement Google Cast sessions and receiver targeting ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/323 )
* Follow the wallpaper palette on Android 12+ ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/325 )
* Keep the no-icon download on the release channel ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/326 )
* Let the Play Games screens follow dark mode ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/327 )
* Dark mode for the remaining light-only screens ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/328 )
* Added network timeouts and better network requests handle ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/285 )

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/compare/7.2.2...7.3.0
